changes: Floating Bar Visual Refinement: Added sleek filled dropdown indicators (▾) beside popup items for audio source, camera overlay, recording mode, and settings.
Optical Icon Sizing & Spacing: Fine-tuned icon scales, optically balanced the settings gear silhouette, and increased inter-item toolbar spacing for a clean, distraction-free HUD.

Fixed Overlay Visibility in App Recording Mode: Included Rec's overlay process in SCContentFilter when recording a specific selected application, ensuring cursor highlights and tap feedback ripples appear reliably across the entire display.
Refreshed About Window: Updated feature showcase highlighting In-App Video Editor, Floating HUD Toast, Dynamic Controls, and classic Contact/GitHub capsule actions.
Enhanced Post-Recording Layout: Increased top margin and spacing above the Play, Edit, Share, and Finder button row for improved visual balance and breathing room.

Floating HUD Toast Notification: Replaced center modal on recording completion with a subtle, non-intrusive bottom-right HUD toast featuring 7-second auto-dismiss, hover-to-pause, and instant left-click playback.
Rich Right-Click Action Menu: Added full contextual menu to the HUD toast with direct access to Edit Video, Copy, Share, Rename, Show in Finder, Full Modal, and Move to Trash.
Adaptive Light & Dark Mode Styling: Enhanced post-recording preview card with frosted translucent glass in light mode and rich recessed styling in dark mode.
Edit Video Nomenclature: Standardized 'Trim' to 'Edit Video' across all menus, buttons, and action sheets.
Strong Frosted Glass & High-Contrast Readouts: Upgraded window glass to high-diffusion popover material and high-contrast green indicators for razor-sharp readability.

In-Place Video Trimming: Trim recordings with 60 FPS ultra-smooth timeline scrubbing, full-track playhead cursor, loop preview bounds, and 1-click in-place overwrite saving directly to the original file without duplicate files.
Audio Mute / Unmute Toggle & Silent Export: Instant 1-click audio muting during trim with dedicated video-only track composition export that strips audio for clean silent clips.

Dynamic Live Recording Bar: Automatically transforms the floating control bar during recording by hiding unchangeable settings popups and displaying a live elapsed duration timer with pulsating recording/pause status indicators.

Last Selected Area Preview & Confirmation: Instant visual boundary preview when selecting the mode from the dropdown, plus an interactive pre-recording confirmation banner with live dimension readout and 1-click Enter/Space to start.
Symmetrical 2x4 Recording Saved Modal: Cleaned up post-recording dialog with a balanced 2x4 action grid (Play, Trim, Share, Finder, Delete, Copy, Rename, Done).
1-Click Clipboard Copy: Added a dedicated Copy button to instantly copy the video file directly to the macOS clipboard for fast pasting across Slack, Discord, Messages, and Mail.
In-Place Video Renaming: Added a Rename action button to instantly rename recordings on disk directly from the modal, immediately refreshing the preview card and metadata.

Clickity-Style Tap Feedback: Replaced legacy black outline circle click visualizer with smooth, hardware-accelerated tap ripple animations (white when cursor highlight is disabled, or matched to the selected cursor highlight color with dual-pulse for right clicks).
High-Framerate & Expanded FPS Options: Added 120 FPS (Ultra Smooth / ProMotion), 90 FPS, and 15 FPS (Compact) capture framerates.
Expanded Resolution Options: Added 480p (Compact / SD) resolution for lightweight screen captures and quick sharing.
Display & Multi-Monitor Safety: Added dynamic multi-monitor re-alignment, screen edge fallback, and main-thread safety protections.
Fixed Floating Bar Dismissal: Resolved an issue where clicking the close button caused the floating control bar to reappear after half a second.
Live Permission & Menu Bar Check Indicators: Upgraded Permissions & Setup guide with real-time status polling checkmarks for Screen Recording, Menu Bar, Accessibility, and Microphone.
Dynamic Version Resolution: Standardized appVersion to load directly from bundle CFBundleShortVersionString with robust fallback.
Installer & GitHub Release Sync: Fixed one-liner terminal installer to fetch and parse version.json ensuring correct version builds across local and CI releases.
Hardware-Accelerated Update Changelog: Replaced legacy text view with a silky smooth SwiftUI ScrollView supporting 120Hz ProMotion momentum scrolling.
Unified About Window Typography & Dynamic Spacing: Adopted 24pt bold typography, vibrant system color SF Symbols, multiline auto-measured spacing, and 26px bottom clearance.
120 FPS Native Update Changelog: Upgraded update dialog with trackpad-smooth AppKit native NSTextView scrolling.
First-Launch Gated Permissions Guide: Eliminated recurring launch modals, prompting only on first install or when essential permissions are missing.

Permissions & System Setup Guide: Added an interactive onboarding and settings window with one-click direct links to open Screen Recording, Menu Bar / Control Center, Accessibility, and Microphone system settings.
Menu & Settings Integration: Added direct 'Permissions & Settings...' access in both the menu bar dropdown and the floating control panel settings menu.
Enhanced First-Launch Flow: Clear setup alerts and guidance on first launch to ensure macOS Tahoe (26+) Menu Bar and Screen Capture permissions are properly enabled.
macOS Tahoe (26) Compatibility: Added applicationShouldHandleReopen handler so clicking the app in Finder or Spotlight restores the floating bar when running as an accessory.
Menu Bar Template Icons: Configured all menu bar SF Symbol status icons with isTemplate = true to adapt properly across light and dark menu bars.
Status Item Fallback: Added automatic detection in hidePanel to restore floating controls if menu bar item visibility is suppressed by system settings.
24-Hour Update Check Rate-Limiting: Automatic background launch update check now respects a strict 24-hour rate limit so it checks at most once per day without pestering.
Screen Capture Window Exclusion: Robust window filtering logic to cleanly exclude floating control panels and menu bar status items from captured recordings.
Floating Panel Menu Enhancements: Added About Rec, Check for Updates, and Quit items directly to the floating control panel settings menu.

Camera Popover Icon Sync: Fixed issue where NSPopUpButton cell failed to select header item 0 and update contentTintColor, ensuring camera icon displays video.fill with green tint whenever camera window is active.
Camera Icon State Sync: Fixed bug where camera status icon incorrectly showed inactive when reopening controls panel or switching cameras while camera overlay was running.
Smooth Update Window Scrolling: Introduced hardware-accelerated SwiftUI ScrollView changelog viewer for 60 FPS / 120 FPS ProMotion trackpad scrolling.
Real-Time Update Check: Purged URLCache and added cache-busting timestamp parameters for zero-delay update notifications.
Cumulative Release Notes: Update alert now parses and displays all unread changes since your current build.
1-Click In-App Auto-Update: Automatically downloads installer and runs Terminal auto-update flow.
Standardized bundle identifier to com.aoh.rec across app bundle, Info.plist, and installer.
Added persistent saving and restoration of last selected recording area across app relaunches.
Added live pixel dimension readout during region selection.
Fixed UI issue causing dark corners on the floating control panel.
Fixed homebrew tap workflow.
Fixed crash when using camera overlay (missing NSCameraUsageDescription).
Fixed CI build pipeline.
Added pause and resume recording.
Added global keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+Shift+R to Record, Cmd+Shift+P to Pause).
Added picture-in-picture camera overlay feature.
Initial release of Rec.
Added native ScreenCaptureKit and AVAssetWriter recording.
Added internal audio and microphone capture.
Added floating control panel and countdown timer.
